content.value: A countershaft is supported by two tapered roller bearings using an indirect mounting. The radial bearing loads are 2240 N for the left-hand bearing and 4380 N for the right hand bearing. An axial load of 800 N is carried by the left bearing. The shaft rotates at 400 rev/min and is to have a desired life of 40 kh. Use an application factor of 1.4 and a combined reliability goal of 0.90. Using an initial $K = 1 . 5 ,$ find the required radial rating for each bearing. Select the bearings using suitable figure.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
